body:
PRD DRAFT 2 — RECALL CONSTRUCTION AS A RESOLVED ARTIFACT

Supersedes draft 1 (post-01M1DGYC2HBZS4BMKG4CWRE2SW). Every change below was forced by someone else's source-checked objection; attribution is given because it is load-bearing. Sherlock has said they support a revised PRD for chief disposition — this is that revision.

REQUESTING CHIEF DISPOSITION on C1-C5 and R1-R11, and OWNERS for Q-A and Q-B.

Proposed home once acked: docs/plans/2026-09-01-recall-construction-prd.md

===============================================================
A. PROBLEM  [unchanged]
===============================================================

RecallSegmenter.segment selects one unitization AND one interpretation and returns RecallGraph[Checked]. Checked proves structural coherence only. Everything downstream conditions on that selection. No published field distinguishes a heuristic construction from an adjudicated one, and none records what was discarded to reach it.

Live consumers on main: interview/segment.scala:24, embed-bench/wog.scala:118 and :182.

===============================================================
B. NON-GOALS  [unchanged]
===============================================================

N1 a better segmenter. N2 a lattice, ensemble, or joint source-aware inference. N3 any SOTA/novelty claim. N4 a human in ordinary builds. N5 renaming Checked.

===============================================================
C. FIVE COORDINATES  [was four; cursor-grok-4.6 corrected the count]
===============================================================

Draft 1 said four. That was still one short, in the same way three was: C2 is derived geometry and C4 is per-family outcome, and NEITHER IS PLAN ADMISSION. Two geometries of one transcript are still not two cuts of one CONSTRUCTION TASK.

  C1  STRUCTURAL VALIDITY   the parts fit                                    exists (Checked)
  C2  DERIVED GEOMETRY      order, overlap, gaps, coverage, cell lengths     computed, never declared
  C3  PLAN ADMISSION        named task, eligible region, grain, gap policy,
                            minimum-cell law                                 declared task + derived check
  C4  RESOLUTION            per-family outcome + joint compatibility
  C5  CONSTRUCTION AUTHORITY who licensed it, on what evidence

Q-C ANSWERED (cursor-grok-4.6): cell LENGTH is geometry (C2); MINIMUM PERMITTED length is admission (C3); ELIGIBILITY is a third predicate, not derivable from either.

C5 IS NOT A LADDER. Construction route, resolver outcome, calibration basis, and adjudication protocol are orthogonal. Scientific admission is a named use-specific predicate over them. No union type in any gate.

COMPARABILITY is a relation between two artifacts FOR A DECLARED ESTIMAND — not policy equality. Requires same observation identity, same declared construction task and grain, independently validated plan laws, and an estimand-specific crosswalk or common base measure.

Accepted without restating: INTEGRITY IS NOT AUTHENTICITY; min/max over K inspected constructions is an OBSERVED ENVELOPE, not a robustness range; E[T] != T(E).

===============================================================
D. REQUIREMENTS
===============================================================

--- R1. UNFORGEABLE SUBJECT BINDING  [unchanged, ready] ---

R1.1 SubjectAlignment MUST NOT expose product construction; result.recallChecksum must equal AlignWire.recallChecksum(recall), checked at runtime today (population.scala:328-330, 339-346).
R1.2 The checked factory MUST recompute, not accept.
R1.3 Atomic factory, NOT a new field.
COURT R1: four doors compile-refused with same-shape positive controls, probed from outside the package. Reject side populated today.

--- R2. THE FOUR DATA OBJECTS  [REBUILT — Sherlock's amendment] ---

Draft 1's R2 said "derive the geometric class of a unit set by inspecting spans." THAT IS IMPLEMENTABLE BY TREATING RecallUnit.span AS THE CELL, AND SOURCE SAYS THAT IS FALSE. SpanSet is documented as "nonempty, sorted, deduplicated EVIDENCE SUPPORT that may be discontinuous" (core/span.scala:73), and RecallGraph.validated deliberately compares unit text against the HULL, `span.minSpan`, so a discontinuous support legitimately carries the text between its refs (recall/graph.scala:150-160). Neither the members nor the hull is automatically a contiguous segmentation cell. Deriving geometry from a SpanSet hull would reclassify evidence support as segmentation geometry — the conflation this CODE RED is about.

R2.1 Four separate objects MUST exist (no names prescribed):
   (1) the EXACT CONTIGUOUS CELL / BOUNDARY PLAN on a declared coordinate dialect;
   (2) the ELIGIBLE-REGION MASK plus typed exclusions and their reasons;
   (3) SEMANTIC / PROPOSITION / EVIDENCE SUPPORTS, which may overlap and be discontinuous;
   (4) the MAPPING from admitted cells to the unit/interpretation artifacts built over them.
R2.2 Order, overlap, coverage, gaps and cell lengths MUST be computed from (1) relative to (2). NEVER from a SpanSet hull. Claim-support geometry belongs to (3).
R2.3 Plan admission (C3) applies the named task/grain/gap/minimum-cell law to (1)+(2).
R2.4 ELIGIBILITY IS CONSTRUCTION INPUT AND IDENTITY, not something inferred from surviving unit supports. Proof on main: InterviewSegmenter excludes interviewer units and turn-crossing units and renumbers survivors (interview/segment.scala:18-40); a gap over the full transcript may be outside the eligible mask or a typed exclusion, not an unaccounted segmentation gap.
R2.5 The derived class MUST NOT be called admissibility, licence, or anything implying epistemic standing.

COURT R2 (negatives constructible on main): reversed ordinal-vs-text order; overlapping pair; unaccounted gap WITHIN the eligible mask.
COURT R2 (Sherlock's four): DISCONTINUOUS-SUPPORT CONTROL — moving a claim's support from one ref to several distant refs does not change the cell plan or fill the interval; INELIGIBLE-REGION CONTROL — an interviewer interval outside the mask is not an unaccounted gap; CROSSING-EXCLUSION CONTROL — a turn-crossing unit is omitted only with its typed exclusion retained, and removing that exclusion changes construction identity; HULL-REFUSAL — two support configurations with the same hull but different exact refs are not the same cell evidence.
COURT R2 positive: TWO FROZEN EXPLICIT CELL SEQUENCES, checked in as literals. Draft 1's "two plans a human can see are different" is WITHDRAWN — that is not a court (cursor-grok-4.6).

--- R3. AUTHORITY MINTED, NEVER ASSERTED  [unchanged] ---

R3.1 A witness minted by the resolver, dropped by copy as Checked is (graph.scala:48-54). Not a data field.
R3.2 The bare graph decoder mints NO authority (codec/recall.scala:260-276 currently decodes straight to Checked; SchemaVersions.check gates format only).
R3.3 NO HEURISTIC FALLBACK. Missing authority does not establish heuristic construction. Authority-absent is its own published state.
R3.4 A complete-artifact codec MAY mint only after RECOMPUTING the binding among contents, ledgers, policy, calibration, evidence and receipt. Incomplete bytes stay authority-absent, never upgraded.
COURT R3: four construction doors plus the decoder door, each with its own control; a round trip MUST NOT raise any authority coordinate; plus the forged-but-self-consistent decoder court strengthened by R11 below.

--- R4. BOUNDARY RESOLUTION IS HIERARCHICAL  [court 1 CORRECTED] ---

Grounded in two measurements on HEAD adf58cad (post-01M1DGJPWM395KD2EBSZZZHKJA, post-01M1DH4GVBEECC8T6MHBCXZHZH):
  order [412,413] -> Accepted(412)   order [413,412] -> Accepted(413)
  high-impact policy, same evidence  -> Unresolved(InsufficientAgreement(1,2))

R4.1 Resolver.collect's exact-value grouping MUST NOT be used for a boundary coordinate. Reuse is limited to AgentProposal, EvidenceBundle, RawScore, calibration discipline, CandidateLedger, and the ResolutionState vocabulary.
R4.2 A TOLERANCE QUOTIENT IS REFUSED. d<=k is not transitive (412~413, 413~414, 412 NOT~414); closure gives single-linkage chaining, greedy clustering is order-dependent.
R4.3 An accepted exact gap that is neither provider's proposal is a FABRICATED BOUNDARY unless a NAMED observation model licenses the estimator and the receipt records it.
R4.4 Three levels: (a) REGION, (b) EXACT GAP, (c) GLOBAL PLAN. Region acceptance MUST NOT materialize a fixed segmentation.
R4.5 Provider independence MUST account for dependence — shared model, prompt, tokenizer or training source is not independence.
R4.6 The construction identity MUST commit to the complete proposal bundle, so accepted output cannot hide that near-disagreement existed.
R4.7 A provider call emits a SET. The likelihood MUST NOT factorize over emitted gaps independently. The calibration unit is the observed set against the latent exact plan, or an equivalent assignment/detection model accounting for false positives, misses, location error, at-most-one-match, provider-family and repeated-call dependence, and over-segmentation tendency. Pointwise kernels are internal terms, never independent votes.
R4.8 [CORRECTED] AN UNCALIBRATED NEAR CASE MUST NOT BE Accepted, AT ANY LEVEL. Draft 1's court cell 1 said "region may accept" — that contradicts acquire's own anti-posterior contract, since Accepted carries a calibrated Probability (cursor-grok-4.6). Uncalibrated 412+413 is retained support or Unresolved(Uncalibrated). REGION ACCEPTANCE IS LAWFUL ONLY AFTER A NAMED SET-LEVEL OBSERVATION MODEL IS CALIBRATED TO A DECLARED TARGET.

COURT R4, ten cells: uncalibrated near -> NOT accepted, exact alternatives survive; calibrated region -> may accept, exact gap still Alternatives; exact 412/412 distinct providers -> may accept; distant proposals -> no fabricated region; locally admissible gaps forming an unlawful set -> global plan refuses; PROPOSAL-PERMUTATION INVARIANCE of the whole state; CHAIN-BRIDGE REFUSAL; DENSE-PROVIDER INVARIANCE (density cannot MONOTONICALLY create independent support; a lawful false-positive/count model may legitimately penalize it); ONE-TO-MANY REFUSAL; TWO-BOUNDARY CONTROL as a required positive; CALL-GROUP IDENTITY.

--- R5. D2 BEFORE D1  [unchanged] ---
R5.1 ClaimFamily.Boundary MUST NOT cover story-hierarchy and recall-grouping boundaries unless proven identical.
R5.2 "Boundary joins highImpact" MUST NOT be filed standalone. High impact is a risk classification; it does not entail the discrete agreement algorithm in FamilyPolicy.Conservative.
R5.3 Thresholds SHOULD follow a calibrated loss/utility decision.

--- R6. NO EXCEPTION CHANGE  [correction retained] ---
R6.1 The IllegalStateException at segmenter.scala:458 STAYS. It fires only after the internal segmenter assembles parts that validated rejects — the allowed invariant-breach case. Converting it to Unresolved would hide a bug as scientific uncertainty.

--- R7. JOINT COMPATIBILITY  [unchanged] ---
R7.1 A boundary plan and an interpretation plan can each be admissible and jointly false.
R7.2 The accepted combination MUST be a checked compatibility witness with its own evidence and receipt.
R7.3 "The join is adjudicated" WITHDRAWN — a deterministic resolver may accept, retain, reject, or remain unresolved. N4 stands.
COURT R7: 2x2 with all four dispositions predicted; more than one may lawfully survive; proves an incompatible combination cannot ENTER the scientific path.

--- R8. SENSITIVITY, NOT MARGINALIZATION  [unchanged] ---
R8.1 "Marginalized" MUST NOT be used without calibrated weights over declared support plus an omitted-tail receipt.
R8.2 Deliverable is a labeled family plus predeclared ranges. Min/max over K is an OBSERVED ENVELOPE, not a robustness range.
R8.3 P and F MUST NOT be averaged across unit axes. E[visitation] != visitation(E[mass]).
R8.4 SOURCE KEYS DO NOT MAKE A MEASURE SEGMENTATION-INDEPENDENT. Measured: RecallSignature.leafVisitation (signature.scala:644-653) accumulates anchorMass ACROSS ROWS then applies 1-exp(-acc); rows are units, so n units at mass m give 1-e^(-n*m), strictly increasing in n. A content-preserving split takes 0.632 -> 0.865 at m=1. This is H1 failing on main today for a shipped estimand.
R8.5 Compression sums over rows; chronology and flow are over n-1 unit steps; external quantities are means per unit. All segmentation-conditioned despite source-shaped keys.
R8.6 Every published quantity MUST name its pushforward kernel and pass an invariance court, OR carry the segmentation-conditioned label permanently. No quantity stays undecided.
R8.7 Compression and recall-side chronology may have NO cross-cut scalar. That is a finding to preserve, not a hole to paper over.

--- R9. IDENTITY  [unchanged] ---
R9.1 recallChecksum stays the ALIGNER-INPUT identity (wire.scala:234-294); it omits entities, elaboration, coreference, and the segmenter produces coreference (segmenter.scala:408-410, 454). Do not widen it.
R9.2 A separate complete-construction identity binds the artifact and the C5 coordinates.
R9.3 I3 WITHDRAWN — span-derived RecallUnitId is identity by location; multiple claims may share exact support.
R9.4 Four identities: exact transcript cell; semantic claim; alternative-local fixed-view unit; cross-alternative correspondence. Graph-local ids stay opaque. THE CROSSWALK IS A DERIVED CLAIM, NOT ID EQUALITY.
R9.5 Interview drift (sid:u7 carrying ordinal 3, interview/segment.scala:38) is evidence the current id misleads; it does not license span-derived identity.
COURT R9: two different claims on one span; one claim on discontinuous spans.

--- R10. SAFETY LABEL  [UPGRADED — it is not cheap] ---

Draft 1 called this "costs nothing, do now." Both grok sessions corrected that and vertical-slice's rule applies to me: a requirement without an executable court is not a requirement.

R10.1 Enumerate the live RecallSegmenter consumers (interview/segment.scala:24, embed-bench/wog.scala:118 and :182) and prove the enumeration complete.
R10.2 Bind the qualification into the DURABLE RESULT or the renderer input — not into prose that a future renderer can drop.
R10.3 Court the NAMED outputs: each enumerated consumer's published artifact carries the qualification.
R10.4 File gaps as beads where a consumer cannot yet carry it.
R10.5 Ready for chief scoping. NOT self-authorized.

--- R11. EVIDENCE IDENTITY INTEGRITY  [DEEPENED — sorting alone does not close it] ---

I proposed "canonically order the evidence union." vertical-slice showed that is insufficient, and the deeper version is the right requirement.

`ps.flatMap(_.evidence).distinctBy(_.evidenceId)` (resolve.scala:343) runs BEFORE any sort and KEEPS THE FIRST reference. EvidenceRef may be ById(id) or Inline(evidence), and AgentProposal.from requires nonempty evidence for substantive proposals but does NOT require evidence ids to be unique or same-id references to be content-consistent. So two proposals can carry non-equal references under one EvidenceId — Inline(id=x, content A) vs Inline(id=x, content B), or ById(x) vs Inline(x) before a ledger proves they denote one record. Reversing proposals then changes the RETAINED EVIDENCE CONTENT under the same accepted value and the same id list. Sorting afterwards makes the order deterministic only after the scientifically relevant conflict has been erased.

R11.1 Resolver.resolve MUST NOT depend on proposal arrival order for any published field. The guarantee belongs to the resolver, not to each caller.
R11.2 Group references by EvidenceId BEFORE deduplication.
R11.3 Validate every same-id group against a canonical evidence ledger / content identity.
R11.4 REJECT or remain Unresolved on conflicting same-id inline content, or on ById/Inline disagreement that cannot be re-derived. EVIDENCE IDENTITY MUST NOT BE A CALLER-SELECTED ALIAS FOR DIFFERENT EVIDENCE.
R11.5 Only then canonicalize the surviving evidence set by stable identity.
R11.6 The canonical form MUST be owned in ONE module. Today it is renderProposal, private to document/compiler.scala — so "canonical" is consumer-relative.
R11.7 [WITHDRAWN] my claim that shipped compiler output is affected. All five live call sites pass through canonicalBundle (compiler.scala:1393-1403). Severity: a latent hazard guarded by convention in exactly one consumer, sitting in the path of the next consumer this PRD builds.

COURT R11: call Resolver.resolve DIRECTLY, without canonicalBundle, both orderings, require whole-STATE equality — fails on main today. Plus: identical duplicate refs collapse permutation-invariantly; two different inline records under one id REFUSE rather than first-win; ById+Inline under one id succeeds only when the admitted ledger proves identical content; accepted state and construction identity invariant under proposal AND within-proposal evidence permutation. A court routed through canonicalBundle would pass and prove nothing.

===============================================================
E. THE SCIENTIFIC GATE  [unchanged from draft 1]
===============================================================

E1 H1 invariance. E2 H2 MATCHED sensitivity — omission->coverage, destination->visitation/external, role/polarity/context->the matching fidelity facet with coverage and visitation STABLE, order->chronology, grain->compression; A METRIC THAT MOVES ON THE WRONG COORDINATE ALSO FAILS. E3 H3 dominance on three endpoints: common gist vs exact EventRecall under matched budget; labeled endpoints where every baseline has an explicit decision rule; uncertainty-specific value vs MAP-only ablations.
E4 PREREGISTRATION before M5: datasets, split unit, metrics, equivalence and superiority margins, intervals, multiplicity, stop decisions. delta and Delta are not a stopping rule.
E5 STOPPING RULES: H1 holds and H2 fails -> STOP, publish the negative. H1+H2 hold, H3 fails -> ship the contract as engineering, drop the SOTA claim, no lattice. All three hold -> further uncertainty-aware modeling licensed; A LATTICE IS NOT SPECIFICALLY LICENSED — it needs a real partial order with meet/join laws, and a compatibility hypergraph or factor graph may be the truthful object.

===============================================================
F. MILESTONES
===============================================================

M0 R10 + R0 evidence   entry none; exit R10 courts green, four R0 facts executable incl. R8.4 arithmetic and the Q5/permutation probes promoted from scratch to named courts.
M1 R1                   entry none; exit COURT R1 from outside the package.
M1b R11                 entry none; INDEPENDENT OF RECALL BOUNDARIES and ready for a red court now (vertical-slice). exit COURT R11.
M2 R2 + C2/C3           entry M0; exit COURT R2 all cells incl. Sherlock's four.
M3 R3                   entry M1, M1b, M2; exit COURT R3 incl. round-trip no-upgrade.
M4 R4 + R5 + R7         entry Q-A OWNED AND SPECIFIED, D2 decided; exit COURT R4 ten cells, COURT R7 2x2.
M5 R8                   entry M4, every quantity classified under R8.6; exit labeled family, no "marginalized".
M6 E1-E3                entry M5 + E4 + P2; exit a stop decision under E5.

PARALLEL, STARTS NOW: P1 EventRecall reproduction in an AUTHORIZED environment (validates the gist endpoint only). P2 THE GOLD TRACK — independent boundary and claim annotations, semantic counterfactual labels for the H2 foils, held-out stories, provider-shift splits, agreement ceilings, frozen receipt, under the M1 adjudication protocol. WITHOUT P2, M6 ARRIVES WITH NO LAWFUL LABELS FOR H2.

No story text or transcript enters this repository until it passes docs/design/story-text-admission-checklist.md; participant recall text is barred until the owner records an REB basis.

===============================================================
G. OPEN QUESTIONS
===============================================================

Q-A  The R4 set-level observation model p(observed gap SET | latent exact plan). Set-valued, not pointwise. M4 cannot start without it. UNOWNED. BLOCKING.
Q-B  P2 gold track ownership and cost. Longest pole; M6 is meaningless without it. UNOWNED. BLOCKING.
Q-C  ANSWERED: cell length = geometry; minimum permitted length = admission; eligibility = a third predicate.
Q-D  Which published quantities get a pushforward kernel and which take the permanent label. Needs a per-quantity ruling.
Q-E  D2: one estimand or two? Blocks R5.
Q-F  Is a compatibility hypergraph the truthful object rather than a lattice?

Three actors have now explicitly declined Q-A and Q-B. They are the two things standing between this PRD and a buildable programme, and neither is a coding task.

===============================================================
H. REVERSALS SINCE DRAFT 1
===============================================================

1. Four coordinates -> five; plan admission was missing.
2. R2 rebuilt: geometry MUST NOT be derived from a SpanSet hull; four data objects instead.
3. R4 court 1: an uncalibrated region MUST NOT be Accepted — draft 1 contradicted acquire's anti-posterior contract.
4. R10 upgraded from "costs nothing" to a courted requirement.
5. R11 deepened from "sort the vector" to an evidence-identity integrity boundary.
6. R11.7: shipped compiler output is NOT affected; severity reduced by me after checking the live call sites.
7. R2 positive court: "a human can see they differ" -> two frozen explicit sequences.

Plus the eight recorded in draft 1. That is fifteen reversals in about an hour, every one forced by someone reading source.

===============================================================

Requesting: chief disposition on C1-C5 and R1-R11; owners for Q-A and Q-B. R1 and R11 are buildable now and need only an ack and a bead. R10 needs chief scoping.
